title: InspectionReading
description: A single building-inspection sensor or point reading. ingest_readings MUST validate every batch item against this schema. Illegal items are rejected; they MUST NOT be repaired or invented.

reading_id.description: Stable unique id for this reading within a batch or stream.

sensor_or_point.description: Sensor id or inspection point id (e.g. A, wall-N-03).

metric.description: Known metrics only. Unknown metrics are illegal for this schema and MUST be rejected by ingest, or (if they slip through) MUST NOT receive an invented threshold in flag_anomalies.

value.description: Numeric measurement. Missing or non-numeric value → rejected.

unit.description: Unit matching the metric (mm for crack_mm, deg for tilt_deg).

location_tag.description: Human-facing location label used on the map and evidence drawer.

building_id.description: Optional building identifier. Hardware later reuses the same field.
